description: This file defines the main activity 'NavigationDrawerActivity' for an Android application that implements a navigation drawer using DrawerLayout, RecyclerView, and ActionBarDrawerToggle. It manages navigation between fragments representing different 'planets', handles action bar interactions, and manages UI state during drawer open/close events.

classes.name: NavigationDrawerActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the navigation drawer, handling user interactions, fragment transactions, and action bar appearance.

classes.name: NavigationDrawerActivity.PlanetFragment
classes.description: Inner static fragment class that displays a planet image and name based on selected list item.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the drawer, adapter, toggle, and default fragment.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu with action items.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adjusts menu item visibility based on drawer state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles action bar item clicks, including toggling drawer and performing web search.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on items in the navigation drawer, updating main content.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Replaces the main content fragment based on selected list item.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Synchronizes drawer toggle state after activity restoration.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Passes configuration change events to the drawer toggle.

methods.name: PlanetFragment.newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new fragment instance for a specific planet based on position.

methods.name: PlanetFragment.onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the fragment's view, setting the planet image and name.
